resolution.question: Will NASA's senior managers publicly announce a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window at the conclusion of the flight readiness review process before the end of June 1969?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that NASA senior managers publicly announced a go decision for Apollo 11's July launch window at the conclusion of the flight readiness review process before 1969-06-30T18:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
